tests.title: TC-01 browse category and open product details

catalogue.objective: Validate the core catalogue navigation journey from category selection to product details.
catalogue.why: A stable smoke scenario covering a common customer journey and an important entry point into shopping flows.
catalogue.expected: The selected category displays products and the product details page exposes the Add to cart action.
catalogue.failure: The report should be checked for navigation or product-detail assertion failures.

tests.title: TC-02 register a unique user and log in

catalogue.objective: Validate new-user registration followed by authentication with the same credentials.
catalogue.why: Authentication is a core functional capability and is repeatable across regression runs.
catalogue.expected: Registration succeeds and the authenticated username is displayed after login.
catalogue.failure: A failure would require investigation of registration, credentials, login or authenticated-state handling.

tests.title: TC-03 add a product to cart and verify the cart total

catalogue.objective: Validate product addition to the cart and verify that the resulting cart total is greater than zero.
catalogue.why: Covers a core purchase step and validates resulting business state rather than only a click or navigation event.
catalogue.expected: The selected product is present in the cart and the cart total is greater than zero.
catalogue.failure: A failure would require investigation of product selection, add-to-cart behaviour, cart state or total calculation.

catalogue.objective: Validate the end-to-end purchase journey and the confirmation details shown after checkout.
catalogue.why: This is a high-value business journey that connects product selection, cart state, checkout and confirmation.
catalogue.expected: A purchase confirmation is displayed and includes the submitted customer name and expected order amount.
catalogue.failure: The current run failed while verifying the customer name. The evidence proves the expected text was not found; it does not by itself prove that the purchase transaction failed.

catalogue.objective: Validate that an order cannot be successfully completed when the cart contains no products.
catalogue.why: Negative-path coverage checks an important business rule that a happy-path suite would not exercise.
catalogue.expected: No successful purchase confirmation is displayed when the cart is empty.
catalogue.failure: The current run displayed a successful purchase confirmation despite an empty cart. This should be reproduced manually before being recorded as a confirmed product defect.
